_doc: WoW item -> BG3 item rules. Read by link/tools/wow_items.py; explained in the inventory notes. Edit numbers here, run wow_items.py again; nothing else changes.
_weapons: WoW weapon subclass -> BG3 weapon stats entry (its root template is the look). 'fast' is used instead when the WoW swing time (delay, ms) is at most fast_delay. Thrown is BG3's dagger: WPN_Dart is a two-handed ranged weapon with ammunition and no Thrown property, and BG3 throws nothing from its ranged slot.
_enchant: Weapon +N (BG3's WeaponEnchantment boost: to hit and damage) from the WoW weapon's damage per second. Thresholds for +1, +2, +3.
_extra_damage: A second WoW damage line (e.g. +5-10 Fire) becomes WeaponDamage(die, type); the die is the first whose average reaches the WoW average x extra_damage_scale.
_armor: Body armour by WoW armour subclass (1 cloth, 2 leather, 3 mail, 4 plate): the BG3 armour type by item level (tiers: [from item level, BG3 stats entry], the last one reached wins). Its AC is BG3's own for that type (base_ac), plus the magic bonus below, as BG3's own +1..+3 armours (Helldusk Armour 21).
_base_ac: BG3's own AC of each base (Shared Armor.txt): robe 10; light padded/leather 11, studded 12 (+ full DEX); medium hide 12, chain shirt 13, scale/breastplate 14, half plate 15 (+ DEX max 2); heavy ring 14, chain mail 16, splint 17, plate 18; shield 2.
_magic: Magic bonus (+AC) on body armour and shields from WoW quality (2 uncommon, 3 rare, 4 epic, 5 legendary) and item level: the highest bonus whose quality and item level are both reached, at most magic_cap.
_slots: WoW inventory type -> BG3. 'base' per armour subclass (0 misc, 1 cloth, 2 leather, 3 mail, 4 plate) or 'any'. Types not listed here have no BG3 equipment slot: they are kept as WoW-worn items (see 'worn').
_small_ac: Head, feet, hands and back pieces give AC(+1) once the item level and quality reach these (BG3's own small pieces give AC only when magic).
_worn: WoW slots with no BG3 slot (shoulders, legs, waist, wrists, shirt, tabard, trinket, off-hand holdable, relic, ammo). Shown in BG3 bags as this item; its stats count while the WoW character wears it.
_abilities: WoW stat -> BG3 ability: +1 per 'per' WoW points, at most 'cap' per item. WoW stat ids: 3 agility, 4 strength, 5 intellect, 6 spirit, 7 stamina.
_resist: WoW resistance (holy, fire, nature, frost, shadow, arcane) of at least resist_at -> BG3 Resistance(type, Resistant).
_objects: Everything else by WoW class (and subclass). 0 consumable, 1 container, 5 reagent, 7 trade goods, 9 recipe, 11 quiver, 12 quest, 13 key, 15 misc. First match wins: 'class:subclass', then 'class'.
_food: WoW consumables whose name contains one of these words use BG3's healing potion, food or drink (their BG3 use effect too). Other consumables are plain items in BG3 until WoW's own use is wired (see inventory.md).
_categories: WoW's own markers: a consumable whose first spell is in spell category 11 is food, 59 drink.
_camp_supply: BG3's camp supply value of WoW's food and drink, by item level: [up to this item level, supply]. A long rest costs BG3's 40, so 4 of the first tier, 3 of the second, then 2 and 1. Tune here.
_supply_by_price: What a food or drink sells for sets its supply: this many times the square root of the price of one (copper), to the nearest step, so dearer food is better but not in full proportion (8 silver pie 80, 5 copper bread 5). camp_supply below is for what no vendor prices.
_water: A drink with water in its name: BG3's water bottle, whatever its level.
_conjured_supply: Conjured food and drink is free to make, so it is worth a flat, small supply whatever its level. WoW sells it for 0.
_food_heal: BG3 base by item level, for its look and size: BG3's food has no use from the bag (only alcohol has). [up to this item level, base].
_alcohol: WoW's own alcohol spells (weak, standard, strong, potent, lager). BG3's beer makes the drinker Drunk. Flat supply: a rest should not be paid in rum.
_effects: The switch: on-equip effects, random suffixes, instant heals. On with 'enabled', wow_items.py --effects or WOW_BG3_ITEM_EFFECTS=1. A member's worn points add up by kind; every 'per' points is {n} in the boost 'b', at most 'cap' ({p} is 100 + n). Every number here is a balance call: docs/item-effects.md.

effects._stats: WoW's aura stat index -> BG3 ability (per and cap: ability_per, ability_cap above).
effects._auras: WoW aura -> kind. 'scale' turns its points into the kind's. school_mask: only when the aura's mask has one of these bits (126 every magic school, not physical).
effects._skills: WoW skill id of a +skill aura: 95 defense (scale: 25 defense count as 5% avoidance).
effects._resist_bits: School bit of a +resistance aura or enchantment: bit 1 armour (scale: 100 armour count as 5% avoidance), the others as 'resist' above.
effects._heal_tiers: A consumable with an instant WoW heal: [from WoW's amount, BG3 potion], the last one reached wins.
effects._consumables: A consumable's BG3 base by what its use spell and the spells it triggers do: the first rule that matches wins. 'effect': WoW spell effect (default 6, apply aura); 'auras', 'misc' (any of), 'mask' (school bits), 'min_bits'; 'with_aura' and 'with_effect' must also be in the chain. tiers: [from WoW's points, BG3 base], the last one reached wins. Food and drink with a camp supply follow a rule only with 'food_from', from those points; below it they stay BG3 food. skip_effects: 24 makes an item, 86 activates an object, 100 alcohol keeps its own rule. conjured_words: what WoW makes for free stays at the first tier. Every choice is a balance call: docs/item-effects.md.
effects._table: Words for wow_items.py effects; nothing else reads them.
